title: HumanApprovalReceipt
description: Approver identity, permitted action digest, scope, expiry and explicit reservations (plan: 'Wire contracts'). Net-new. expiry is the envelope's expires_at. Structurally this object cannot bind to a prohibited action digest by itself — that a reserved/prohibited effect requires (or cannot receive) an approval is enforced by admission logic (E2), not by this schema; see docs/enforcement/threat-model.md.

permitted_action_digest.description: binds this approval to one exact admitted action digest

reservations.description: explicit conditions the approver attached; an empty array means none were attached, never omitted
